context.preFounder: You are exploring founding a company together
context.existingTeam: You already work together as a founder team

setup.title: Founder Setup
setup.description: Capture important shared understandings about collaboration, ownership, and change.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Your existing perspectives, reports, and discussion work.
alignment.empty: This team does not have a shared alignment area yet.
alignment.noArtifacts: No reports or shared work areas are available for this connection yet.

agreements.title: Agreements
agreements.description: Entry points to the areas where you have already captured agreements.
agreements.empty: No shared agreements have been captured yet.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.description: Advisor access to your existing alignment areas.

commitmentLab.title: Commitment Lab
commitmentLab.description: Clarify what you can realistically contribute, what your commitment means to you, and what should happen when time, motivation, or life circumstances change.
commitmentLab.intro: What does your commitment mean in real life? Commitment Lab supports reflection and conversation. It does not assess either of you or your collaboration.

personal.title: Your personal reality check
personal.help: Complete this section from your perspective today. Your responses are not evaluated as a commitment score.
personal.currentHours: How many hours can you realistically contribute per week right now?
personal.difficultHours: How many hours would still be realistic in a much fuller or more difficult week?
personal.obligations: Which regular commitments also require your time? (optional)
personal.changeNote: What could change your time or organizational situation over the next few months?
personal.realityFit: Does your planned commitment fit your current reality?

realityOptions.partly: Partly — I would like to look more closely.
realityOptions.reconsider: I would assess my original expectation differently today.

meaning.title: What does commitment mean to you?
meaning.core: What does “I am in” mean to you when motivation, time, or external circumstances change?
meaning.aspectsHelp: The following aspects structure your reflection. They are not a psychometric scale and are not scored.
meaning.priority: What place does the startup have alongside your other commitments when several things matter at the same time?
meaning.reliability: What does your commitment mean during periods when motivation or progress is much lower than you hoped?
meaning.transparency: When should your co-founder learn that you will probably no longer be able to keep your previous commitment?
meaning.responsibility: What do you want to do with responsibilities you have already taken on if your own capacity changes?
meaning.renegotiation: When is it legitimate for you to renegotiate commitment?

scenarios.title: Reality and stress scenarios
scenarios.help: There is no right or wrong answer. Describe what you would probably do.
scenarios.expectation: What should your co-founder be able to expect from you in this situation?
scenarios.motivation_progress: You have been working for several months, but progress and motivation are much lower than at the beginning.
scenarios.time_circumstances: Work or private circumstances suddenly require much more of your time than expected.
scenarios.attractive_alternative: You receive a professional opportunity that is financially or professionally very attractive.
scenarios.team_responsibility: Your co-founder has not completed agreed responsibilities as discussed for several weeks.

compare.title: Your perspectives
compare.ready: You have both captured your personal perspectives. Compare your responses and discuss what they mean for you.
compare.waiting: Still open: the shared comparison appears once both founders have completed the personal core sections.

discussion.title: Shared conversation
discussion.help: Use the questions as conversation prompts and capture your thoughts. Posts are visible to both founders in this relationship.

prompts.meaning: What does “I am in” mean concretely to each of you?
prompts.less: When is it legitimate for each of you to contribute less?
prompts.expectation: What do you expect from each other when someone can no longer keep their previous commitment?
prompts.timing: How early do you want to discuss changes?
prompts.renegotiation: When should an individual change lead to a shared renegotiation?

discussion.postPlaceholder: What would you like to capture from the conversation?
discussion.replyPlaceholder: What would you like to reply?

reflection.title: What are you taking away from your Commitment Lab?
reflection.help: Capture what you learned about your expectations around commitment and responsibility. This is not yet a confirmed agreement.

handoff.title: Continue in Founder Setup
handoff.help: Would you like to record something for your collaboration? Deliberately choose the appropriate Founder Setup item.
handoff.existing: This topic already has a shared working note. It will not be overwritten.
handoff.three: This reflection comes from a pairwise founder relationship. Continue it with the whole team in Founder Setup; it will not be copied automatically.

feedback.error: The change could not be saved safely right now.

speech.unavailable: Dictation is not available in this browser right now.

connections.title: Your founder connections
connections.subtitle: Find the founders you are exploring a collaboration with or already working with.

established.title: Shared areas
established.description: Long-term workspaces for your established founder connections.
established.empty: You do not have a long-term founder connection yet.

potential.title: Introductions and alignment
potential.description: Open requests and connections where you are still exploring a collaboration.
potential.empty: There are no open or ongoing connections right now.

setup.title: Founder Setup
setup.subtitle: Work through the topics that matter for your collaboration, one step at a time.
setup.summary: {clarified} captured · {discussing} being discussed · {open} open · {pending} confirmations open
setup.legalGeneral: CoFoundery helps you structure topics for discussion and clarification. The specific legal or tax implementation may require professional advice.
setup.legalSpecific: The specific legal or tax implementation of this topic may require professional advice.

advisorAccess.title: Share Founder Setup with an advisor
advisorAccess.description: The advisor can read only your jointly confirmed Founder Setup content. Working notes and open proposals remain private.
advisorAccess.notShared: Not shared with this advisor yet.
advisorAccess.pending: Approval from all current founders is not yet complete.
advisorAccess.active: The jointly confirmed content is shared with this advisor.

advisorView.title: Founder Setup
advisorView.subtitle: Points jointly confirmed by the founder team.

discussion.title: Discussion & notes
discussion.help: Collect thoughts, questions, and perspectives here. Then use the shared working note to summarize what you want to take forward.
discussion.visibility: These contributions are visible to all current founders on this team.
discussion.empty: No contributions on this topic yet.
discussion.postPlaceholder: What would you like to add to this topic?
discussion.replyPlaceholder: What would you like to reply?
discussion.dictationUnavailable: Dictation is currently unavailable in this browser.

detail.workingHelp: Use this space to collect thoughts and open points. The note is not yet a jointly confirmed position.
detail.proposalHelp: The proposal becomes the jointly confirmed position only after every current founder has agreed to it.
detail.proposalReplacesPending: A new proposal replaces the open proposal. The position you have already confirmed together remains unchanged until everyone agrees to the new proposal.
detail.proposalNote: What would you like to capture together?
detail.resolutionStatus: How would you like to capture this point?
detail.documentationReference: For “Documented” only: Where did you capture this? (optional)
detail.documentationPlaceholder: For example, a document name or https://…

feedback.proposed: The shared wording was proposed for confirmation.
feedback.error: The change could not be saved safely right now. Please try again.

roles_responsibilities.title: Roles & responsibilities
roles_responsibilities.question: Who takes ownership of which areas, and where are the boundaries for responsibilities and decisions?

decision_rights.title: Decisions & decision rights
decision_rights.question: What do you decide together, what can individual founders decide, and how do you handle different judgments?

time_commitment.title: Time & commitment
time_commitment.question: How much time can and does each person want to contribute right now, and which changes should you discuss early?

communication.title: Communication & ways of working
communication.question: How do you want to share information, coordinate, give feedback, and stay reachable day to day?

conflict_deadlock.title: Conflict & deadlock
conflict_deadlock.question: How do you want to raise disagreements, and what will you do when you cannot move forward on an important question?

equity.title: Equity split
equity.question: How should equity be divided, and what considerations are behind that distribution?

vesting.title: Vesting & cliff
vesting.question: Should equity be tied to time or contribution, and what should apply if someone leaves early?

compensation.title: Salary & compensation
compensation.question: When and under what conditions do you want to compensate yourselves, and how will you handle different levels of compensation?

contributions_expenses.title: Contributions, expenses & founder loans
contributions_expenses.question: How will you handle personal funds, expenses, contributions, or loans that founders provide for the company?

personal_financial_risk.title: Personal financial risk
personal_financial_risk.question: Which financial commitments can and does each person want to take on, and which ones explicitly not?

legal_entity.title: Legal entity & formal setup
legal_entity.question: Which formal incorporation steps are still open, and where might you need professional advice?

founder_agreements.title: Company & founder agreements
founder_agreements.question: Which important understandings do you want to record in a binding written form?

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual property / IP
intellectual_property.question: How do you want to handle existing and future code, designs, brands, content, inventions, or other work products?

outside_activities.title: Outside activities & other projects
outside_activities.question: Which other jobs, companies, or projects are running in parallel, and what would you like to clarify transparently with each other?

accounts_access.title: Accounts, access & key company information
accounts_access.question: How will you ensure that important accounts, access, and company information do not depend on only one person?

prolonged_absence.title: Extended absence
prolonged_absence.question: How do you want to proceed if a founder is absent for an extended period or becomes significantly less available?

changing_commitment.title: Changing commitment or role
changing_commitment.question: What do you want to clarify if someone wants to change their scope, responsibilities, or role significantly?

founder_exit.title: Founder exit
founder_exit.question: What should be clarified if a founder wants to leave the company or the founder team?

dashboard.title: My founder teams
dashboard.description: Open the shared overview for an existing founder team.
dashboard.empty: New founder teams appear here once a shared connection has been created.
